# noust_team (Resource)

A team: the unit that owns projects, environments and, through them, applications, databases and backup schedules. Creating one also creates its `default` project with a `production` environment. Deleting a team is refused by the server while it still holds anything.

Needs the permission `teams.manage` and sudo mode to delete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "noust_team" "acme" {
  name = "Acme"
  slug = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The team's display name.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) The team's slug, which commands and links name it by. Made from the name when omitted. Changing it replaces the team.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The team's slug.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The team's slug.
terraform import noust_team.acme acme
```
